description: This file defines the WPEFramework Plugin::Probe class, which includes nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism using Web requests over UDP datagrams, with functionalities for sending, receiving, and handling responses, as well as managing probe instances and broadcasting messages.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing functionality with nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance management.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for socket buffer processing.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for Web requests and responses over UDP datagrams, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Broadcasts M-SEARCH requests over UDP datagrams, manages destinations and request creation.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

methods.name: WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into socket buffer format.

methods.name: Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial request.

methods.name: Broadcaster::Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to broadcast destinations.

methods.name: Broadcaster::SendData
methods.description: Prepares and sends data over UDP datagram.

methods.name: Broadcaster::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a M-SEARCH request string, optionally signs it if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.
